name: Shot Freeze Probe (research)
description: Research only, towards a true time stop: can what is in flight be held where it is and let go as it was? Ctrl+F11 stops time: shots and rockets, thrown grenades and knives, seeking missiles and every lit fuse are held until pressed again, and fire, gas and arc damage is withheld meanwhile; the log says what each did. Nothing happens on its own. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
